hl-0011.answer_text:
This has been escalated to a person because the combined return value is over £100 and requires senior review.

The customer is asking to return both items from verified order 52001 because they do not fit the space: one Brass floor lamp (£74) and one Side table, pair (£58). The order was delivered on 15 September 2026 via standard delivery. The combined value is £132; no refund is recorded.

Urgency: routine. This is a change-of-mind return request, with no safety issue or time-critical consequence stated.
